thesisQuality.note: Power and sensing address durable electrification needs with improving Q2 execution, while EPP commercial-scale adoption and acquisition outcomes remain unproven.

financialOperatingMomentum.note: Q2 revenue rose 9% YoY, GAAP operating margin reached 16.1%, and free cash flow of $425.4m quadrupled YoY, though cycle volatility remains.

marketValuationOpportunity.note: Current valuation is balanced-to-attractive if the earnings recovery persists, but not distressed.

catalystScore.note: AI data-center revenue growth, EPP/GaNEXUS ramps, next earnings and the planned Synaptics transaction provide identifiable catalysts with execution uncertainty.

governancePower.note: Improving operating leverage, repurchases and portfolio focus support capital-allocation credibility; planned acquisition and manufacturing intensity prevent stronger treatment.

alignment2036.note: Power conversion and sensing serve AI infrastructure, automotive electrification, robotics and industrial energy efficiency across long-duration needs.

crossDivisionLeverage.note: Core power and sensing capabilities span AI data centers, automotive and industrial infrastructure, providing multiple demand engines.

bottleneckControl.note: Power-density and thermal constraints are real system bottlenecks and EPP targets them, but commercial-scale proof and unique control are not established.

scenarioRobustness.note: AI infrastructure, automotive and industrial electrification diversify demand, though semiconductor cycles and technology shifts remain material.

substitutionResilience.note: Qualification and differentiated power architectures create friction, while competing silicon, SiC, GaN and packaging solutions remain credible substitutes.

supplyChainResilience.note: Owned manufacturing provides control but inventory, fab utilization, yield and semiconductor supply dependencies remain meaningful.

pricingPower.note: 38.4% GAAP gross margin and improving operating leverage support moderate value capture, but cyclical competition and utilization limit scarcity-rent evidence.

risk.note: Risks include cyclical demand, capital intensity/utilization, EPP adoption and yield uncertainty, competing architectures and acquisition execution.

confidence.note: Operating results and identity are primary-source supported and valuation is independently current; confidence is reduced for EPP commercial economics and future acquisition outcomes.

thesis: onsemi combines improving cash generation with durable power-conversion exposure across AI, automotive and industrial markets, while cyclicality, capital intensity and unproven new-platform economics cap conviction.
keyRisk: AI/power expectations outrun actual qualification, utilization and economic returns while competing architectures or a semiconductor downturn compress margins.
nextCatalyst: November 2026 earnings and evidence of AI data-center, EPP/GaNEXUS customer ramps and Synaptics transaction progress.
